summary: Going Down, Monday hooks night. I added two topics, the Kola Superdeep Borehole (the feed's top score, 9.71) and Paris under the streets (8.78, now sourced). I gave Hongyancun a breakout reference, added evidence to the hidden-hook challenger and made one kit proposal.
why: Demand scan: 'deepest hole' Shorts reach 6-27M (8.2M on a 201K channel), and a Paris Catacombs Short has 2.4M on 824 subscribers. Every big dive-shaped Short promises what is at the bottom; our three titles all ask 'How deep does X go?'. Our own Shorts (436, 424, 263 views) have no retention data yet.

findings.title: Deepest hole on Earth: 8.2M on 201K subscribers (41x)
findings.detail: More Shorts on the same idea at 27M, 25M, 12M and 6.3M. A pure vertical dive, exactly our format.

findings.title: Paris Catacombs: 2.4M on 824 subscribers
findings.detail: The breakout held back on 22 Nov now has four sourced depths (20, 25, 36 and 52 m).

findings.title: Top titles promise what is at the bottom
findings.detail: Examples: 'what was inside it is terrifying' (12M), 'bigger than you think' (2.4M), 'Then Discovered THIS' (772K). Our titles all ask 'How deep does X go?'.

findings.title: Hongyancun: 225K on 1.9K subscribers
findings.detail: A breakout reference for a topic already in the feed; its score went from 5.34 to 7.69.

changes.title: 2 topics added, 1 re-referenced
changes.detail: Kola Superdeep Borehole (high) and Paris (normal) added; Hongyancun given a breakout reference.

changes.title: Backlog: more evidence for gd-hidden-hook
changes.detail: Tonight's titles of 0.8-12M dive Shorts; it stays first among the first-second challengers.

changes.title: Proposal gd-meter-km-scale
changes.detail: The dive kit's depth meter must show km (Kola goes to 12,262 m) and space layers by order.
